description:
The all-new CHASE Edge is a race-ready BMX bike, ideal for riders looking to get serious and take their riding to the next level. Already considered a refined machine, the new Edge has been further improved: it now features Shimano hydraulic disc brakes (on Junior sizes and up; mechanical for Micro and Mini), all-new 2-piece aluminum Chase cranksets with a 24mm spindle (Expert XL and up), optimized gear ratios and crank arm lengths, a two-tone paint job with fresh graphics, and enclosed dropouts with an integrated chain tensioning system. The Edge frame is constructed from triple-butted, hydroformed 6061 aluminum tubing and features an integrated head tube. Other highlights include a 4130 chromoly steel fork and handlebar (on the Micro model), Ikon Carbon fork options on two colorways, double-wall rims, a cassette rear hub with a triple-pawl engagement system, and Vee Rubber Speedster tires. The combination of these components arguably makes the CHASE Edge one of the highest-performing race BMX bikes on the market today.

The new Edge also sports a two-tone paint scheme and chrome or gold decals applied beneath the clear coat. Built using components from the industry's top brands, the Edge incorporates pro-level parts across several sizes, including Tioga tires, IKON Carbon forks, Chase 2-piece cranksets (24mm spindle), Insight chainrings, Shimano brakes, a cassette rear hub with a triple-pawl engagement system, KMC chains, and a NEW COMBO seat with an integrated post. With a lineup spanning 9 sizes, the Edge offers a perfect fit for riders of virtually every age and size.
